WWE '12 PC - licences
=====================

This port is free software under the GNU General Public License v3.0 (licenses\GPL-3.0.txt).
Its source code: {SOURCE_URL}

It includes the native renderer of nefariousjosiah's SmackDown vs. Raw ports (GPL-3.0), and
builds on the components below, which keep their own licences. Their licence texts are in the
"licenses" folder.

It contains NO game data. WWE '12 is (c) WWE, THQ and Yuke's; this fan project is not affiliated
with them.


In wwe12.exe
------------

- re:Blue renderer core (zolaware/reblue): BSD 3-Clause - licenses\reblue.txt
- plume (zolaware/plume): MIT - licenses\plume.txt
- zstd (decoder): BSD - licenses\zstd.txt
- disruptorplus: MIT - licenses\disruptorplus.txt
- RenderDoc API header: MIT - licenses\renderdoc_app.txt
- Shaders converted with XenosRecomp (zolaware/reblue-XenosRecomp): MIT - licenses\XenosRecomp.txt


In rexruntime.dll and rexgpu-xenos.dll (ReXGlue SDK)
----------------------------------------------------

- ReXGlue SDK (portions from Xenia): BSD 3-Clause - licenses\rexglue-sdk.txt
- FFmpeg (libavcodec, libavutil; game audio): LGPL 2.1 or later - licenses\FFmpeg-LGPL-2.1.txt
- libmspack (LZX decoder): LGPL 2.1 - licenses\libmspack-LGPL-2.1.txt
- SDL 3: zlib - licenses\SDL3.txt
- Dear ImGui: MIT - licenses\imgui.txt
- fmt: MIT - licenses\fmt.txt
- spdlog: MIT - licenses\spdlog.txt
- toml++: MIT - licenses\tomlplusplus.txt
- xxHash: BSD 2-Clause - licenses\xxHash.txt
- utf8-cpp: Boost Software License 1.0 - licenses\utfcpp.txt
- o1heap: MIT - licenses\o1heap.txt
- aes_128: MIT - licenses\aes_128.txt
- SIMDe: MIT - licenses\simde.txt
- glslang: BSD 3-Clause and others - licenses\glslang.txt
- Vulkan Memory Allocator: MIT - licenses\VulkanMemoryAllocator.txt
- Vulkan headers and loader, SPIR-V headers and tools (Khronos): Apache 2.0 / MIT -
  licenses\vulkan-headers.txt, licenses\vulkan-loader.txt, licenses\spirv-headers.txt,
  licenses\spirv-tools.txt

The LGPL libraries (FFmpeg, libmspack) are linked unmodified into rexruntime.dll. You may
replace them with your own versions: rebuild rexruntime.dll from the ReXGlue SDK source (see the
source code link above) and put it next to wwe12.exe.
